prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square promotional detail poster for a BADASS lucky draw voucher event. Show a left hand fanning out multiple blue voucher cards with white borders over a beige stone countertop. The front-most card should feature vertical BADASS branding on the left stub, the word 'TẶNG', and a large yellow '100K'. Add a black BADASS wordmark at the top right. In the lower-left area place large blue text 'TẶNG VOUCHER MUA SẮM GIÁ TRỊ!'. In the lower-right area place a yellow-highlighted blue banner reading 'THỬ TÀI VẬN MAY' above blue text 'NHẬN QUÀ BẤT NGỜ'. Technical style: photorealistic promotional detail poster, soft indoor commercial lighting, crisp card edges, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
